title: Main and grievance dashboard API performance
summary: Refactored GET /api/dashboard and GET /api/grievance/dashboard to reduce redundant aggregations and heavy audit_log subqueries. Main dashboard uses entity counts with optional date filters; grievance dashboard metrics live in GrievanceDashboardStats with shared GrievanceDashboardFilter. Escalation SLA uses denormalized current_level_started_at (migration 066).

items: Multi-valued indexes on grievance_type_ids and grievance_category_ids
MEMBER OF() replaces JSON_CONTAINS in dashboard breakdowns and respondent history
Optional date_from/date_to on main dashboard; profile/structure/grievance created counts from tables with JOINs
Indexed audit_log JOINs for image uploads and grievance status changes
Shared project/date filter for all grievance dashboard queries
Single GROUP BY status for total + breakdown; preloaded progress levels for escalation row actions
current_level_started_at column; sqlDaysOpenExceedsSla(); applyEscalationClock on status/level change
api-smoke.spec.ts: grievance dashboard envelope + main dashboard date filter
CHANGES.md, API_CONTRACT.md updated for both dashboard endpoints
